title: Retirement-plan beneficiary designations
facts: Retirement accounts and employer plans can pass according to valid beneficiary designations rather than ordinary instructions in a will, subject to plan terms and federal or state law.
ERISA-covered retirement plans generally provide special protections for spouses, and spousal consent can be required for certain beneficiary choices.
Beneficiary designations should be reviewed after major life events such as marriage, divorce, birth or death.
A will should not be assumed to override a valid retirement-plan beneficiary designation.
